title: Specialty
description: Represents the master specialty list, including custom specialties, to include crosswalk between NUCC, HSD, and ABMS Specialties.  References the entities for NUCC, HSD, and ABMS specialties.

classificationSource.description: The source of the specialty classification (e.g., NUCC, HSD, ABMS).

subspecialtyName.description: The subspecialty name of the specialty.

taxonomyCode.description: The taxonomy code associated with the specialty.

taxonomyDescription.description: The description of the taxonomy code.
